question.problem:
Which of the following vector spaces has a dimension of $49?$

I. ${R}_{7}[t]$, the vector space of all polynomials in the variable $t$ of degree at most $7$

II. ${R}^{7}$

III. ${\text{M}}_{7}(R),$ the vector space of all $7\times 7$ matrices over $R$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine each of the vector spaces in turn.

I. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}_{n}[t])=n+1.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}_{7}[t])=7+1=8\ne 49.\,\times 
  $$

II. Recall that $\text{dim}({R}^{n})=n.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({R}^{7})=7\ne 49.\,\times 
  $$

III. Recall that $\text{dim}({\text{M}}_{n}(R))={n}^{2}.$ Therefore, 

  $$
  \text{dim}({\text{M}}_{7}(R))={7}^{2}=49.\,✓
  $$

Hence, the correct answer is "III only."
